- name: int_marketo__lead
      description: Lead dimension with merge/delete flags derived from activity tables; all leads from staging are retained (no filtering)
      grain: One row per input row in staging.stg_marketo__lead; duplicates on lead_id are preserved
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_marketo__lead
      - staging.stg_marketo__activity_merge_leads
      - staging.stg_marketo__activity_delete_lead
      business_logic: '- Start with all rows from staging.stg_marketo__lead (no filtering or deduping in this model). - Build deleted_leads as the distinct set of lead_id from staging.stg_marketo__activity_delete_lead. - Build unique_merges from staging.stg_marketo__activity_merge_leads by: - Grouping by lead_id and concatenating distinct merged_lead_ids separated by ", ". - Null policy: null merged_lead_ids are ignored; if no non-null values exist for a lead, the result is null. - Ordering: no explicit ordering is applied during concatenation, so the sequence is not guaranteed. - Left join deleted_leads and unique_merges to the lead base on lead_id. - Compute flags: - is_deleted = TRUE if a matching deleted_leads.lead_id exists, else FALSE. - is_merged = TRUE if merged_into_lead_id is not null, else FALSE. - Select all original lead attributes unchanged (formatting preserved), plus is_deleted, merged_into_lead_id, and is_merged.'
      columns:
      - name: lead_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Lead identifier from staging; grain follows source and duplicates (if any) are preserved.
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: email
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Email from staging; passed through unchanged
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: first_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: First name from staging; passed through unchanged
      - name: last_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Last name from staging; passed through unchanged
      - name: created_timestamp
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Creation timestamp from staging; passed through as VARCHAR
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: updated_timestamp
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Last updated timestamp from staging; passed through as VARCHAR
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: is_deleted
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: TRUE if lead_id appears in staging.stg_marketo__activity_delete_lead, else FALSE (never NULL)
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: merged_into_lead_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Comma+space separated distinct merged_lead_ids per lead_id; nulls excluded; order not guaranteed; null when no non-null values exist.
      - name: is_merged
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: TRUE if merged_into_lead_id is not null, else FALSE (never NULL)
        tests:
        - not_null

- name: marketo__change_data_details
      description: Daily flags per lead indicating which tracked Marketo lead fields changed based on change data value activities before today.
      grain: One row per lead_id and date_day for any day before today with at least one change data value activity.
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_marketo__activity_change_data_value
      - staging.stg_marketo__lead_describe
      business_logic: '- Read change events (lead_id, activity_timestamp, primary_attribute_value_id) from staging.stg_marketo__activity_change_data_value. - Read field metadata (lead_describe_id, rest_name_xf) from staging.stg_marketo__lead_describe. - Left join events to metadata on primary_attribute_value_id = lead_describe_id to get primary_attribute_column (unmatched rows have it null). - Keep only events whose activity date is earlier than the current date (exclude today and future). - Derive date_day as the calendar date of activity_timestamp. - Group by lead_id and date_day. - For each tracked field, set the flag to TRUE if any event in the group has primary_attribute_column equal to the token, compared case-insensitively; otherwise FALSE. Tokens → columns: - ''email'' → email_c - ''firstname'' → first_name_c - ''lastname'' → last_name_c - ''company'' → company_c - ''title'' → title_c - ''phone'' → phone_c - ''industry'' → industry_c - ''country'' → country_c - ''state'' → state_c - ''city'' → city_c - ''leadsource'' → lead_source_c - ''leadstatus'' → lead_status_c - ''rating'' → rating_c - ''leadscore'' → lead_score_c - ''unsubscribed'' → unsubscribed_c - ''donotcall'' → do_not_call_c - ''emailinvalid'' → email_invalid_c - Boolean aggregation is an OR across events within the day; duplicates do not change the result; NULL primary_attribute_column never matches; groups may have all flags FALSE. - Compute lead_day_id as a deterministic MD5 hash of the concatenation: lead_id, an underscore, and date_day; treat NULLs as empty strings and use the default date-to-string format.'
      columns:
      - name: lead_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Marketo lead identifier; grouping key for aggregation.
        tests:

blocks.original_text:
- name: marketo__change_data_scd
      description: Type 2 SCD of lead attributes with daily versions, backfilling email/first/last via field-level flags, row-only values for company/lead_status, and a deterministic surrogate key.
      grain: Rows per lead_id per valid_to date from the unioned snapshot and change data; no enforced uniqueness.
      source_models:
      - intermediate.marketo__change_data_pivot
      - intermediate.int_marketo__lead
      - intermediate.marketo__change_data_details
      business_logic: '- Read sources: - leads: current lead snapshot (one row per lead as of today). - change_data: historical daily changes by lead and date. - details: field-level boolean flags by lead and date indicating whether a field change boundary exists. - Build the unioned set: - From leads: emit one row per lead with date_day = today; populate email/first_name/last_name; set other fields (e.g., company, lead_status) to null. - Union all rows from change_data (one per lead_id and date_day) with their recorded values. - Prepare partitions for backfill: - valid_to equals the row’s date_day (today for snapshot rows; change date for change_data rows). - Join details on lead_id and date_day. - For each of email, first_name, and last_name, compute a descending-date group number per lead that increases on every row except when both conditions hold: the field value is null and the corresponding details flag is false. These groups define contiguous runs across which missing values should be carried backward. - Backfill fields: - For email, first_name, and last_name: within each lead and group, carry the most recent non-null value (from the later date in that group) backward to earlier dates; if a group has no non-null value, the field remains null. - Non-backfilled fields: - company and lead_status take only the value present on that specific row/date; values are not carried across dates and nulls remain null. - Surrogate key: - lead_day_id is the MD5 hash of lead_id and valid_to concatenated with an underscore; nulls are treated as empty strings. - Output columns: valid_to, lead_id, email_c, first_name_c, last_name_c, company_c, lead_status_c, lead_day_id. No de-duplication is applied; multiple rows may exist for a lead and date if both sources supply that date.'
      columns:
      - name: valid_to
        data_type: DATE
        description: Version date equal to the row’s date_day (today for snapshot rows; the change date for historical rows).
      - name: lead_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Lead identifier carried through from the unioned inputs.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: email_c
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Email after carrying the latest available value backward within groups that continue only when the field is null and the details flag is false; otherwise the group breaks; remains null if no later non-null exists.
      - name: first_name_c
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: First name after carrying the latest available value backward within groups that continue only when the field is null and the details flag is false; otherwise the group breaks; remains null if no later non-null exists.
      - name: last_name_c
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Last name after carrying the latest available value backward within groups that continue only when the field is null and the details flag is false; otherwise the group breaks; remains null if no later non-null exists.
      - name: company_c
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Company value taken only from the same row/date; no cross-date fill; nulls preserved.
      - name: lead_status_c
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Lead status taken only from the same row/date; no cross-date fill; nulls preserved.
      - name: lead_day_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Deterministic MD5 hash of lead_id and valid_to joined by '_' with nulls treated as empty strings.

      - name: count_unique_opens
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of lead_id values in the email_send_id group; duplicates collapsed and NULL lead_id excluded.
        tests:
        - not_null

blocks.original_text:
- name: marketo__campaigns
      description: Campaign dimension enriched with email performance metrics aggregated by campaign_id.
      grain: One row per input row in staging.stg_marketo__campaigns
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_marketo__campaigns
      - marts.marketo__email_sends
      business_logic: '- Begin with all rows and columns from staging.stg_marketo__campaigns; no filtering or deduplication is applied. - From marts.marketo__email_sends, keep only rows where campaign_id is present and aggregate by campaign_id: - count_sends: number of email_sends rows. - count_opens, count_bounces, count_clicks, count_deliveries, count_unsubscribes: total each metric across rows; null values in these fields are ignored in the totals. - count_unique_opens: number of distinct email_send_id where was_opened is true; null email_send_id are excluded. - count_unique_clicks: number of distinct email_send_id where was_clicked is true; null email_send_id are excluded. - Left join these aggregates to the campaigns on campaign_id; if no matching aggregate exists, set all metrics to 0. - Output one row for every input row in staging; if multiple rows share the same campaign_id, they all receive the same aggregated metrics.'
      columns:
      - name: is_active
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Whether the campaign is currently active.
      - name: created_timestamp
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Campaign creation timestamp as a string from the source.
      - name: description
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Campaign description text from the source.
      - name: campaign_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Campaign identifier used to join email performance aggregates; rows sharing the same campaign_id receive the same metrics.
      - name: campaign_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Campaign display name from the source.
      - name: program_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Owning program identifier from the source.
      - name: campaign_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Campaign type classification from the source.
      - name: updated_timestamp
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Last update timestamp as a string from the source.
      - name: workspace_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Marketo workspace name of the campaign.
      - name: computed_url
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source-provided URL for the campaign record.
      - name: flow_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Associated flow identifier from the source.
      - name: folder_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Folder identifier containing the campaign.
      - name: folder_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Type of the folder containing the campaign.
      - name: is_communication_limit_enabled
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Whether communication limits are enabled for the campaign.
      - name: is_requestable
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Whether the campaign can be requested.
      - name: is_system
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Whether the campaign is a system campaign.
      - name: max_members
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Maximum allowed campaign members.
      - name: qualification_rule_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Qualification rule type for campaign membership.
      - name: qualification_rule_interval
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Numeric interval used in qualification rules.
      - name: qualification_rule_unit
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Time unit for the qualification rule interval.
      - name: recurrence_start_at
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Recurrence start timestamp as a string.
      - name: recurrence_end_at
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Recurrence end timestamp as a string.
      - name: recurrence_interval_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Type of recurrence interval (e.g., daily, weekly).
      - name: recurrence_interval
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Numeric recurrence interval value.
      - name: recurrence_weekday_only
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Whether recurrence occurs only on weekdays.
      - name: recurrence_day_of_month
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Day of month used for recurrence.
      - name: recurrence_day_of_week
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Day of week used for recurrence.
      - name: recurrence_week_of_month
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Week of month used for recurrence.
      - name: smart_list_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Identifier of the smart list associated with the campaign.
      - name: status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Campaign operational status from the source.

        description: Number of email_sends rows linked to this campaign_id; zero when no matching rows.

        description: Total deliveries across email_sends rows for this campaign_id; null values are ignored; zero when no matches.
      - name: count_unsubscribes

      - name: count_unique_opens
        data_type: BIGINT

      - name: count_unique_clicks

references.line_text: business_logic: '- Begin with all rows and columns from staging.stg_marketo__campaigns; no filtering or deduplication is applied. - From marts.marketo__email_sends, keep only rows where campaign_id is present and aggregate by campaign_id: - count_sends: number of email_sends rows. - count_opens, count_bounces, count_clicks, count_deliveries, count_unsubscribes: total each metric across rows; null values in these fields are ignored in the totals. - count_unique_opens: number of distinct email_send_id where was_opened is true; null email_send_id are excluded. - count_unique_clicks: number of distinct email_send_id where was_clicked is true; null email_send_id are excluded. - Left join these aggregates to the campaigns on campaign_id; if no matching aggregate exists, set all metrics to 0. - Output one row for every input row in staging; if multiple rows share the same campaign_id, they all receive the same aggregated metrics.'

blocks.original_text:
- name: marketo__email_funnel_dashboard
      description: Time-series email funnel with daily (date+campaign+template) and weekly (week+campaign) rows, including counts, unique recipients, engagement actions, rates, and week-over-week opened comparisons.
      grain: 'Daily: one row per send_date, campaign_id, email_template_id; Weekly: one row per week_start, campaign_id'
      source_models:
      - marts.marketo__email_sends
      business_logic: '- Filter input to email sends with a non-null email_send_id; use email_send_id, lead_id, campaign_id, email_template_id, activity_timestamp, flags (delivered/opened/clicked/bounced/unsubscribed), and per-email action counts (opens, clicks, bounces, deliveries, unsubscribes). - Build daily metrics by grouping on the send date (from activity_timestamp), campaign_id, and email_template_id: - Volumes: total sends, plus counts of sends where each flag is true; missing or false flags do not count. - Unique recipients: distinct lead_ids overall, and distinct lead_ids where each flag is true. - Action totals: sum per-email opens and clicks; NULL values are ignored in the sum; the sum is NULL only if all inputs are NULL. - Build weekly metrics by grouping daily results by the calendar week start (Monday) of send_date and campaign_id: - Weekly totals are sums of the daily metrics; weekly unique recipient metrics are sums of daily distinct counts (no re-deduplication across the week). - Compute previous-week benchmarks using the prior weekly totals per campaign ordered by week start. - Final output is a UNION ALL of: - Daily rows: analysis_type=''daily''; period_identifier is the string form of send_date; campaign_id and email_template_id populated; open/click action totals populated; prev_period_comparison=NULL; actual_date=send_date. - Weekly rows: analysis_type=''weekly''; period_identifier is the string form of week_start; email_template_id=NULL; open/click action totals NULL; prev_period_comparison is the percent change in opened vs the previous week within the same campaign, rounded to 2 decimals; actual_date=week_start. - Per-row rates: - Delivery rate is the percentage of delivered among sent; 0 when sent is 0. - Open rate is the percentage of opened among delivered; 0 when delivered is 0. - Click-through rate is the percentage of clicked among opened; 0 when opened is 0. - All rates are DOUBLE percentages rounded to 2 decimals. - Nulls and determinism: - Counts exclude NULLs; sums ignore NULLs and return NULL only if all inputs are NULL. - Week starts Monday; period_identifier is the default string cast of the DATE.'
      columns:
      - name: analysis_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Indicates aggregation level: ''daily'' for daily rows and ''weekly'' for weekly rows.'
      - name: period_identifier
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: String form of actual_date (send_date or week_start) using DuckDB’s default DATE-to-VARCHAR cast.
      - name: campaign_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Campaign for the period grouping; carried from source and may be NULL.
      - name: email_template_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Template for daily rows; NULL for weekly rows.
      - name: period_emails_sent
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total emails sent in the period; weekly rows sum daily totals.
      - name: period_emails_delivered
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Emails marked delivered in the period; weekly rows sum daily delivered counts.
      - name: period_emails_opened
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Emails with an open event in the period; weekly rows sum daily opened counts.
      - name: period_emails_clicked
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Emails with a click event in the period; weekly rows sum daily clicked counts.
      - name: period_emails_bounced
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Emails with a bounce event in the period; weekly rows sum daily bounced counts.
      - name: period_emails_unsubscribed
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Emails with an unsubscribe event in the period; weekly rows sum daily unsubscribe counts.
      - name: period_unique_recipients
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Distinct recipients in the period; weekly rows add daily distinct counts without re-deduplication.
      - name: period_unique_opened
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Distinct recipients who opened in the period; weekly rows add daily distinct counts without re-deduplication.
      - name: period_unique_clicked
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Distinct recipients who clicked in the period; weekly rows add daily distinct counts without re-deduplication.
      - name: total_open_actions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total opens across emails in the period; daily rows sum per-email opens; weekly rows are NULL; may be NULL if all inputs are NULL.
      - name: total_click_actions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total clicks across emails in the period; daily rows sum per-email clicks; weekly rows are NULL; may be NULL if all inputs are NULL.
      - name: period_delivery_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent of delivered among sent, rounded to 2 decimals; 0 when sent is 0.
      - name: period_open_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent of opened among delivered, rounded to 2 decimals; 0 when delivered is 0.
      - name: period_click_through_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent of clicked among opened, rounded to 2 decimals; 0 when opened is 0.
      - name: prev_period_comparison
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Weekly-only percent change in opened vs previous week within the same campaign, rounded to 2 decimals; NULL for daily rows or when previous week is missing or either week has zero opens.
      - name: actual_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: 'Date of the period: send_date for daily rows or week_start for weekly rows (week starts Monday).'

blocks.original_text:
- name: marketo__email_sends
      description: Email sends fact table with engagement counts and flags plus campaign and template attributes (one row per email_send_id)
      grain: One row per email_send_id
      source_models:
      - intermediate.marketo__email_sends_deduped
      - intermediate.marketo__opens__by_sent_email
      - intermediate.marketo__bounces__by_sent_email
      - intermediate.marketo__clicks__by_sent_email
      - intermediate.marketo__deliveries__by_sent_email
      - intermediate.marketo__unsubscribes__by_sent_email
      - staging.stg_marketo__campaigns
      - staging.stg_marketo__email_template_history
      business_logic: '- Begin with intermediate.marketo__email_sends_deduped, which has one row per email_send_id and all original send fields. - Left join the aggregated opens, bounces, clicks, deliveries, and unsubscribes models by email_send_id; if any count is missing, use 0. - Set flags: was_opened is true when count_opens is greater than zero; was_bounced when count_bounces is greater than zero; was_clicked when count_clicks is greater than zero; was_delivered when count_deliveries is greater than zero; was_unsubscribed when count_unsubscribes is greater than zero. These flags are never null. - Left join campaigns (staging.stg_marketo__campaigns) on campaign_id to add campaign_type and program_id; if no match, these remain null. - Left join email templates (staging.stg_marketo__email_template_history) on email_template_id to add operational as is_operational; if no match, is_operational remains null. - Output includes all base send columns unchanged, the five count_* fields with missing values defaulted to 0, the five was_* flags, and the three joined attributes; no additional filtering, ordering, or deduplication is performed.'
      columns:
      - name: activity_timestamp
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Timestamp of the send activity.
      - name: activity_type_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Marketo activity type identifier for the send.
      - name: campaign_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Campaign ID associated with the send; join key to campaigns.
      - name: campaign_run_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Campaign run identifier for the send.
      - name: email_template_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Email template ID used for the send; join key to email template history.
      - name: activity_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Underlying Marketo activity ID for this send.
      - name: lead_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Lead (person) ID who was sent the email.
      - name: primary_attribute_value
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Primary attribute value from the send activity payload.
      - name: primary_attribute_value_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Primary attribute value ID from the send activity payload.
      - name: email_send_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Unique identifier of a deduplicated email send event; exactly one output row per value.
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: activity_rank
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Rank used upstream for deduplication; passed through unchanged.
      - name: count_opens
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Aggregated opens for this email_send_id; defaults to 0 when no opens are found.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: count_bounces
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Aggregated bounces for this email_send_id; defaults to 0 when no bounces are found.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: count_clicks
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Aggregated clicks for this email_send_id; defaults to 0 when no clicks are found.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: count_deliveries
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Aggregated deliveries for this email_send_id; defaults to 0 when no deliveries are found.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: count_unsubscribes
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Aggregated unsubscribes for this email_send_id; defaults to 0 when none are found.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: was_opened
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True when count_opens is greater than zero; otherwise false; never null.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: was_bounced
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True when count_bounces is greater than zero; otherwise false; never null.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: was_clicked
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True when count_clicks is greater than zero; otherwise false; never null.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: was_delivered
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True when count_deliveries is greater than zero; otherwise false; never null.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: was_unsubscribed
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True when count_unsubscribes is greater than zero; otherwise false; never null.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: campaign_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Campaign type from campaigns; may be null if no matching campaign.
      - name: program_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Program ID from campaigns; may be null if no matching campaign.
      - name: is_operational
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Operational flag from email template history joined by email_template_id; may be null if no match.

blocks.original_text:
- name: marketo__email_stats__by_campaign
      description: Email engagement metrics aggregated per campaign_id from marts.marketo__email_sends.
      grain: One row per non-null campaign_id
      source_models:
      - marts.marketo__email_sends
      business_logic: '- Start from marts.marketo__email_sends and keep only rows where campaign_id is not null. - Group rows by campaign_id. - Metrics: - count_sends: number of rows in the group (every row counts). - count_opens, count_bounces, count_clicks, count_deliveries, count_unsubscribes: total of the respective field across rows; null values are ignored; if all values are null within a group, the result is null. - count_unique_opens: number of distinct email_send_id values where was_opened is true; null email_send_id are ignored; the same id is counted once; returns 0 if none qualify. - count_unique_clicks: number of distinct email_send_id values where was_clicked is true; same null and deduplication rules as unique opens; returns 0 if none qualify. - Output is one row per campaign_id with no additional filtering, ordering, or deduplication.'
      columns:
      - name: campaign_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Campaign identifier used as the grouping key; non-null and unique per row in this output.
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: count_sends
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Total number of email_sends rows for the campaign after excluding null campaign_id.
      - name: count_opens
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total of count_opens across rows in the campaign; nulls are ignored; returns null if all values are null.
      - name: count_bounces
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total of count_bounces across rows in the campaign; nulls are ignored; returns null if all values are null.
      - name: count_clicks
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total of count_clicks across rows in the campaign; nulls are ignored; returns null if all values are null.
      - name: count_deliveries
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total of count_deliveries across rows in the campaign; nulls are ignored; returns null if all values are null.
      - name: count_unsubscribes
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total of count_unsubscribes across rows in the campaign; nulls are ignored; returns null if all values are null.
      - name: count_unique_opens
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of email_send_id with was_opened true within the campaign; null ids ignored; duplicates counted once; returns 0 if none qualify.
      - name: count_unique_clicks
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of email_send_id with was_clicked true within the campaign; null ids ignored; duplicates counted once; returns 0 if none qualify.

blocks.original_text:
- name: marketo__email_stats__by_lead
      description: Email engagement metrics aggregated per lead from marts.marketo__email_sends.
      grain: One row per lead_id
      source_models:
      - marts.marketo__email_sends
      business_logic: '- Read input rows from marts.marketo__email_sends using: lead_id, email_send_id, count_opens, count_bounces, count_clicks, count_deliveries, count_unsubscribes, was_opened, was_clicked. - Exclude rows with NULL lead_id; group remaining rows by lead_id to produce one row per lead_id. - Metrics per group: - count_sends: number of rows in the group (no filtering; duplicates remain). - count_opens / count_bounces / count_clicks / count_deliveries / count_unsubscribes: add the respective values across the group; NULLs are ignored; if every value is NULL the result is NULL; duplicates remain. - count_unique_opens: number of distinct email_send_id among rows where was_opened is TRUE; rows where was_opened is not TRUE or is NULL are ignored; NULL email_send_id are not counted; returns 0 if none. - count_unique_clicks: number of distinct email_send_id among rows where was_clicked is TRUE; rows where was_clicked is not TRUE or is NULL are ignored; NULL email_send_id are not counted; returns 0 if none. - No joins, sorting, or additional filters beyond the lead_id IS NOT NULL predicate.'
      columns:
      - name: lead_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Lead identifier used for grouping; rows with NULL lead_id are excluded, yielding exactly one row per lead_id.
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: count_sends
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of email_send rows for the lead; duplicates counted; always ≥ 1 and never NULL.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: count_opens
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total opens across sends; NULLs ignored in the sum; returns NULL only if all values are NULL.
      - name: count_bounces
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total bounces across sends; NULLs ignored in the sum; returns NULL only if all values are NULL.
      - name: count_clicks
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total clicks across sends; NULLs ignored in the sum; returns NULL only if all values are NULL.
      - name: count_deliveries
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total deliveries across sends; NULLs ignored in the sum; returns NULL only if all values are NULL.
      - name: count_unsubscribes
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total unsubscribes across sends; NULLs ignored in the sum; returns NULL only if all values are NULL.
      - name: count_unique_opens
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct sends opened where was_opened is TRUE; NULL email_send_id excluded; returns 0 if none; never NULL.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: count_unique_clicks
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct sends clicked where was_clicked is TRUE; NULL email_send_id excluded; returns 0 if none; never NULL.
        tests:
        - not_null

blocks.original_text:
- name: marketo__email_templates
      description: Email template dimension (most recent version) joined to aggregated send engagement metrics
      grain: One row per email_template_id (most recent version only)
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_marketo__email_template_history
      - marts.marketo__email_sends
      business_logic: '- From staging.stg_marketo__email_template_history, keep only rows marked as the most recent version; these provide template metadata. - From marts.marketo__email_sends, exclude rows where email_template_id is null and aggregate by email_template_id: - count_sends: number of send rows. - count_opens, count_bounces, count_clicks, count_deliveries, count_unsubscribes: sum of the respective per-send counts; null values in those fields are ignored by the summation. - count_unique_opens: number of distinct email_send_id where was_opened is true. - count_unique_clicks: number of distinct email_send_id where was_clicked is true. - Left join the template metadata to the aggregated stats on email_template_id. - If a template has no matching sends, output 0 for all metrics; there is exactly one row per email_template_id from the most recent-version metadata.'
      columns:
      - name: created_timestamp
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Template creation timestamp from the most recent version record (raw string)
      - name: description
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Template description text from Marketo
      - name: folder_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: ID of the Marketo folder containing the template
      - name: folder_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Type of folder containing the template
      - name: from_email
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Configured sender email address for the template
      - name: from_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Configured sender name for the template
      - name: email_template_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Template identifier; primary grouping and join key; exactly one output row per value
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: email_template_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Display name of the email template
      - name: operational
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Operational email flag as stored in Marketo
      - name: program_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Associated Marketo program ID for the template
      - name: publish_to_msi
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Flag indicating publish to MSI
      - name: reply_email
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Configured reply-to email address
      - name: email_template_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Template status string from Marketo
      - name: subject
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Configured email subject line
      - name: template
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Template content/type reference as stored (raw string)
      - name: text_only
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Flag indicating the template is text-only
      - name: updated_timestamp
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Last update timestamp from the most recent version record (raw string)
      - name: url
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: URL or path for the template asset
      - name: version
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Numeric version of the template record
      - name: web_view
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Flag indicating web view availability
      - name: workspace
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Workspace name associated with the template
      - name: is_most_recent_version
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Always TRUE; rows are filtered to the most recent template version
      - name: count_sends
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of send records for this template; 0 if none

- name: marketo__lead_history
      description: Daily lead field history built from a calendar spine joined to change data at valid_to, with values carried backward from change days.
      grain: One row per lead_id per date_day
      source_models:
      - intermediate.marketo__change_data_scd
      - intermediate.marketo__lead_calendar_spine
      business_logic: '- Build a daily spine of (lead_id, date_day) from intermediate.marketo__lead_calendar_spine and keep dates up to today. - Left join the spine to intermediate.marketo__change_data_scd on lead_id and date_day equals the change record''s valid_to; mark whether a change row exists for that date. - For each lead_id, traverse dates in descending order and count change occurrences cumulatively; this count defines contiguous partitions that start on a change day and extend backward to the prior change. - For each field (email_c, first_name_c, last_name_c, company_c, lead_status_c), assign the value recorded on the partition’s starting change day to all dates within that partition (i.e., carried backward until the previous change). - Null handling: if the change day’s field value is NULL, NULL persists throughout that partition; dates after the most recent change remain NULL until a change occurs. - Create a deterministic surrogate key by hashing the concatenation of date_day and lead_id, using "_" as a separator and empty strings for any missing components. - Output columns: date_day, lead_id, email_c, first_name_c, last_name_c, company_c, lead_status_c, lead_history_id.'
      columns:
      - name: date_day
        data_type: DATE
        description: Calendar date from the spine restricted to today and earlier; used to build the surrogate key.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: lead_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Lead identifier from the calendar spine; used to build the surrogate key.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: email_c
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Email value set on the change day and carried backward to earlier dates until the previous change; NULLs propagate and dates after the latest change remain NULL.
      - name: first_name_c
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: First name set on the change day and carried backward to earlier dates until the previous change; NULLs propagate and dates after the latest change remain NULL.
      - name: last_name_c
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Last name set on the change day and carried backward to earlier dates until the previous change; NULLs propagate and dates after the latest change remain NULL.
      - name: company_c
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Company set on the change day and carried backward to earlier dates until the previous change; NULLs propagate and dates after the latest change remain NULL.
      - name: lead_status_c
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Lead status set on the change day and carried backward to earlier dates until the previous change; NULLs propagate and dates after the latest change remain NULL.
      - name: lead_history_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Deterministic surrogate key created by hashing date_day and lead_id joined with '_' and replacing any NULLs with empty strings.
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique

blocks.original_text:
- name: marketo__lead_intelligence_simple
      description: Simplified lead intelligence metrics and segments for non-deleted, non-merged leads with email engagement-derived scores and recommendations
      grain: One row per lead_id from intermediate.int_marketo__lead where NOT is_deleted AND NOT is_merged
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_marketo__lead
      - marts.marketo__email_sends
      business_logic: '- Build lead_base from intermediate.int_marketo__lead with lead_id, email, first_name, last_name, created_timestamp, updated_timestamp, filtering out deleted and merged leads. - Aggregate marts.marketo__email_sends by lead_id for records with a non-null lead_id: - total_emails_sent: count of all send records. - total_emails_opened: count of records flagged as opened. - total_emails_clicked: count of records flagged as clicked. - total_emails_bounced: count of records flagged as bounced. - total_unsubscribes: count of records flagged as unsubscribed. - unique_campaigns_participated: count of distinct non-null campaign_id. - first_email_sent_at: earliest activity_timestamp. - last_email_sent_at: latest activity_timestamp. - last_email_opened_at: latest activity_timestamp among records flagged as opened. - last_email_clicked_at: latest activity_timestamp among records flagged as clicked. - email_open_rate_pct: opens divided by sends, multiplied by 100, rounded to two decimals; set to 0 if sends are 0. - email_click_rate_pct: clicks divided by sends, multiplied by 100, rounded to two decimals; set to 0 if sends are 0. - total_lead_score: opens*5 plus clicks*10. - Derive segmentation per lead_id from the aggregated metrics: - rfm_segment by total_lead_score: Champion (>=100), Loyal Customer (>=50), Potential Loyalist (>=25), Regular Subscriber (>=10), At Risk (>=5), else Inactive. - value_tier by total_lead_score: Platinum (>=80), Gold (>=50), Silver (>=25), Bronze (>=10), else Basic. - lead_quality_tier by rates: A-Tier (open>=50 and click>=10), B-Tier (open>=30 and click>=5), C-Tier (open>=15), D-Tier (open>=5), else Unqualified. - Join lead_base to email_engagement and lead_segmentation with left joins on lead_id. - Default handling: - Counts, distincts, rates, and score are set to 0 if no engagement data is found. - rfm_segment defaults to "Unknown", value_tier to "Basic", and lead_quality_tier to "Unqualified" when segmentation is missing. - first/last timestamps remain null if the event never occurred. - days_since_last_* are the calendar days between the date of the last event and today; set to 9999 if the last event is missing. - lead_tenure_days is the calendar days between the lead''s created date and today. - lead_health_status (in order): Healthy if score>=50 and last open within 30 days; Good if score>=25 and within 60 days; Fair if score>=10 and within 90 days; Poor if score>=5; else Critical. - next_best_action (in order): Schedule Sales Call if click rate>=10 and last click within 7 days; Send Product Demo if open rate>=30; Re-engagement Campaign if last open is over 60 days ago and there has been at least one open; Welcome Series if there have been no opens; else Standard Campaign Flow. - last_updated_at is set to the current timestamp at query execution with time zone.'
      columns:
      - name: lead_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Unique Marketo lead identifier; one output row per lead_id
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: email
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Lead email address from intermediate.int_marketo__lead
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: first_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Lead first name from intermediate.int_marketo__lead
      - name: last_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Lead last name from intermediate.int_marketo__lead
      - name: lead_created_at
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Original created_timestamp from the lead source passed through as text
      - name: total_emails_sent
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of email sends for the lead; 0 if none
        tests:
        - total_emails_sent >= 0
      - name: total_emails_opened
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of sends flagged as opened; 0 if none
        tests:
        - total_emails_opened >= 0
      - name: total_emails_clicked
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of sends flagged as clicked; 0 if none
        tests:
        - total_emails_clicked >= 0
      - name: total_emails_bounced
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of sends flagged as bounced; 0 if none
        tests:
        - total_emails_bounced >= 0
      - name: total_unsubscribes
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of sends flagged as unsubscribed; 0 if none
        tests:
        - total_unsubscribes >= 0
      - name: unique_campaigns_participated
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct non-null campaigns the lead participated in; 0 if none
        tests:
        - unique_campaigns_participated >= 0
      - name: email_open_rate_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Opens divided by sends times 100 rounded to two decimals; 0 when sends are 0
        tests:
        - email_open_rate_pct BETWEEN 0 AND 100
      - name: email_click_rate_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Clicks divided by sends times 100 rounded to two decimals; 0 when sends are 0
        tests:
        - email_click_rate_pct BETWEEN 0 AND 100
      - name: total_lead_score
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Engagement score computed as opens*5 plus clicks*10; 0 if no engagement
        tests:
        - total_lead_score >= 0
      - name: first_email_sent_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Earliest email send timestamp; null if never sent
      - name: last_email_sent_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Most recent email send timestamp; null if never sent
      - name: last_email_opened_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Most recent open timestamp among send records flagged as opened; null if never opened
      - name: last_email_clicked_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Most recent click timestamp among send records flagged as clicked; null if never clicked
      - name: days_since_last_email

references.line_text: business_logic: '- Build lead_base from intermediate.int_marketo__lead with lead_id, email, first_name, last_name, created_timestamp, updated_timestamp, filtering out deleted and merged leads. - Aggregate marts.marketo__email_sends by lead_id for records with a non-null lead_id: - total_emails_sent: count of all send records. - total_emails_opened: count of records flagged as opened. - total_emails_clicked: count of records flagged as clicked. - total_emails_bounced: count of records flagged as bounced. - total_unsubscribes: count of records flagged as unsubscribed. - unique_campaigns_participated: count of distinct non-null campaign_id. - first_email_sent_at: earliest activity_timestamp. - last_email_sent_at: latest activity_timestamp. - last_email_opened_at: latest activity_timestamp among records flagged as opened. - last_email_clicked_at: latest activity_timestamp among records flagged as clicked. - email_open_rate_pct: opens divided by sends, multiplied by 100, rounded to two decimals; set to 0 if sends are 0. - email_click_rate_pct: clicks divided by sends, multiplied by 100, rounded to two decimals; set to 0 if sends are 0. - total_lead_score: opens*5 plus clicks*10. - Derive segmentation per lead_id from the aggregated metrics: - rfm_segment by total_lead_score: Champion (>=100), Loyal Customer (>=50), Potential Loyalist (>=25), Regular Subscriber (>=10), At Risk (>=5), else Inactive. - value_tier by total_lead_score: Platinum (>=80), Gold (>=50), Silver (>=25), Bronze (>=10), else Basic. - lead_quality_tier by rates: A-Tier (open>=50 and click>=10), B-Tier (open>=30 and click>=5), C-Tier (open>=15), D-Tier (open>=5), else Unqualified. - Join lead_base to email_engagement and lead_segmentation with left joins on lead_id. - Default handling: - Counts, distincts, rates, and score are set to 0 if no engagement data is found. - rfm_segment defaults to "Unknown", value_tier to "Basic", and lead_quality_tier to "Unqualified" when segmentation is missing. - first/last timestamps remain null if the event never occurred. - days_since_last_* are the calendar days between the date of the last event and today; set to 9999 if the last event is missing. - lead_tenure_days is the calendar days between the lead''s created date and today. - lead_health_status (in order): Healthy if score>=50 and last open within 30 days; Good if score>=25 and within 60 days; Fair if score>=10 and within 90 days; Poor if score>=5; else Critical. - next_best_action (in order): Schedule Sales Call if click rate>=10 and last click within 7 days; Send Product Demo if open rate>=30; Re-engagement Campaign if last open is over 60 days ago and there has been at least one open; Welcome Series if there have been no opens; else Standard Campaign Flow. - last_updated_at is set to the current timestamp at query execution with time zone.'

business_logic: '- Build lead_base from intermediate.int_marketo__lead with lead_id, email, first_name, last_name, created_timestamp, updated_timestamp, filtering out deleted and merged leads. - Aggregate marts.marketo__email_sends by lead_id for records with a non-null lead_id: - total_emails_sent: count of all send records. - total_emails_opened: count of records flagged as opened. - total_emails_clicked: count of records flagged as clicked. - total_emails_bounced: count of records flagged as bounced. - total_unsubscribes: count of records flagged as unsubscribed. - unique_campaigns_participated: count of distinct non-null campaign_id. - first_email_sent_at: earliest activity_timestamp. - last_email_sent_at: latest activity_timestamp. - last_email_opened_at: latest activity_timestamp among records flagged as opened. - last_email_clicked_at: latest activity_timestamp among records flagged as clicked. - email_open_rate_pct: opens divided by sends, multiplied by 100, rounded to two decimals; set to 0 if sends are 0. - email_click_rate_pct: clicks divided by sends, multiplied by 100, rounded to two decimals; set to 0 if sends are 0. - total_lead_score: opens*5 plus clicks*10. - Derive segmentation per lead_id from the aggregated metrics: - rfm_segment by total_lead_score: Champion (>=100), Loyal Customer (>=50), Potential Loyalist (>=25), Regular Subscriber (>=10), At Risk (>=5), else Inactive. - value_tier by total_lead_score: Platinum (>=80), Gold (>=50), Silver (>=25), Bronze (>=10), else Basic. - lead_quality_tier by rates: A-Tier (open>=50 and click>=10), B-Tier (open>=30 and click>=5), C-Tier (open>=15), D-Tier (open>=5), else Unqualified. - Join lead_base to email_engagement and lead_segmentation with left joins on lead_id. - Default handling: - Counts, distincts, rates, and score are set to 0 if no engagement data is found. - rfm_segment defaults to "Unknown", value_tier to "Basic", and lead_quality_tier to "Unqualified" when segmentation is missing. - first/last timestamps remain null if the event never occurred. - days_since_last_* are the calendar days between the date of the last event and today; set to 9999 if the last event is missing. - lead_tenure_days is the calendar days between the lead''s created date and today. - lead_health_status (in order): Healthy if score>=50 and last open within 30 days; Good if score>=25 and within 60 days; Fair if score>=10 and within 90 days; Poor if score>=5; else Critical. - next_best_action (in order): Schedule Sales Call if click rate>=10 and last click within 7 days; Send Product Demo if open rate>=30; Re-engagement Campaign if last open is over 60 days ago and there has been at least one open; Welcome Series if there have been no opens; else Standard Campaign Flow. - last_updated_at is set to the current timestamp at query execution with time zone.'

blocks.original_text:
- name: marketo__leads
      description: Lead dimension combining base Marketo profile with merge/delete flags and aggregated email engagement metrics.
      grain: One row per lead_id
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_marketo__lead
      - staging.stg_marketo__activity_merge_leads
      - staging.stg_marketo__activity_delete_lead
      - marts.marketo__email_sends
      business_logic: '- Start from staging.stg_marketo__lead (one row per lead_id). - From staging.stg_marketo__activity_merge_leads, for each lead_id, combine merged_lead_ids into a single string separated by ", " after removing duplicates; missing values are ignored and ordering is not enforced. - Identify deleted leads as the set of lead_ids appearing in staging.stg_marketo__activity_delete_lead. - Enrich the base leads via left joins: - is_deleted is true when the lead_id appears in the deleted set; otherwise false. - merged_into_lead_id is the combined string of merged IDs for the lead; null when none exist. - is_merged is true when merged_into_lead_id is populated; otherwise false. - Compute email engagement metrics from marts.marketo__email_sends grouped by lead_id: - count_sends equals the total number of send records for the lead. - count_opens, count_bounces, count_clicks, count_deliveries, count_unsubscribes are the sums of their respective per-send counters; missing values in those counters do not contribute. - count_unique_opens equals the number of unique email_send_id values with an open event. - count_unique_clicks equals the number of unique email_send_id values with a click event. - Records without email_send_id do not contribute to the unique counts. - Left join the email metrics to the enriched leads by lead_id and set all email metrics to 0 when no send records exist or the aggregate is missing. - Emit all base lead fields plus the flags and email metrics; exactly one row per lead_id.'
      columns:
      - name: lead_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Unique lead identifier from stg_marketo__lead; one row per lead_id.
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: created_timestamp
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Creation timestamp from stg_marketo__lead, passed through as a string.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: updated_timestamp
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Last update timestamp from stg_marketo__lead, passed through as a string.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: email
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Email address from stg_marketo__lead, passed through as-is.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: first_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: First name from stg_marketo__lead; may be NULL.
      - name: last_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Last name from stg_marketo__lead; may be NULL.
      - name: is_deleted
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True if the lead_id appears in stg_marketo__activity_delete_lead; otherwise false.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: merged_into_lead_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Comma-separated merged_lead_ids per lead after removing duplicates; missing values ignored; NULL when none; ordering unspecified.
      - name: is_merged
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True when merged_into_lead_id is populated; otherwise false.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: count_sends
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Total email send records for the lead; 0 when none.
        tests:
        - not_null
        - count_sends >= 0
      - name: count_opens
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of per-send opens for the lead; missing values ignored; 0 when none.
        tests:
        - not_null
        - count_opens >= 0
      - name: count_bounces
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of per-send bounces for the lead; missing values ignored; 0 when none.
        tests:
        - not_null
        - count_bounces >= 0
      - name: count_clicks
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of per-send clicks for the lead; missing values ignored; 0 when none.
        tests:
        - not_null
        - count_clicks >= 0
      - name: count_deliveries
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of per-send deliveries for the lead; missing values ignored; 0 when none.
        tests:
        - not_null
        - count_deliveries >= 0
      - name: count_unsubscribes
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of per-send unsubscribes for the lead; missing values ignored; 0 when none.
        tests:
        - not_null
        - count_unsubscribes >= 0
      - name: count_unique_opens
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of unique email_send_id values with an open event; records without identifiers ignored; 0 when none.
        tests:
        - not_null
        - count_unique_opens >= 0
      - name: count_unique_clicks
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of unique email_send_id values with a click event; records without identifiers ignored; 0 when none.
        tests:
        - not_null
        - count_unique_clicks >= 0

references.name: staging.stg_marketo__lead
references.line_text: business_logic: '- Start from staging.stg_marketo__lead (one row per lead_id). - From staging.stg_marketo__activity_merge_leads, for each lead_id, combine merged_lead_ids into a single string separated by ", " after removing duplicates; missing values are ignored and ordering is not enforced. - Identify deleted leads as the set of lead_ids appearing in staging.stg_marketo__activity_delete_lead. - Enrich the base leads via left joins: - is_deleted is true when the lead_id appears in the deleted set; otherwise false. - merged_into_lead_id is the combined string of merged IDs for the lead; null when none exist. - is_merged is true when merged_into_lead_id is populated; otherwise false. - Compute email engagement metrics from marts.marketo__email_sends grouped by lead_id: - count_sends equals the total number of send records for the lead. - count_opens, count_bounces, count_clicks, count_deliveries, count_unsubscribes are the sums of their respective per-send counters; missing values in those counters do not contribute. - count_unique_opens equals the number of unique email_send_id values with an open event. - count_unique_clicks equals the number of unique email_send_id values with a click event. - Records without email_send_id do not contribute to the unique counts. - Left join the email metrics to the enriched leads by lead_id and set all email metrics to 0 when no send records exist or the aggregate is missing. - Emit all base lead fields plus the flags and email metrics; exactly one row per lead_id.'

blocks.original_text:
- name: marketo__operational_health_simple
      description: Simplified marketing operations health snapshot with deliverability, lead, campaign, and stability metrics
      grain: Single-row snapshot at query time
      source_models:
      - marts.marketo__email_sends
      - intermediate.int_marketo__lead
      business_logic: '- Build daily_email_volume from marts.marketo__email_sends where activity_timestamp is present, grouped by the calendar date of activity_timestamp: - Per-day counts: total emails sent, unique recipients, active campaigns, unique templates, delivered, opened, clicked, bounced, unsubscribes. - Daily rates as percentages rounded to 2 decimals: - daily_delivery_rate_pct = delivered / total * 100; if total = 0 then 0. - daily_open_rate_pct = opened / delivered * 100; if delivered = 0 then 0. - daily_bounce_rate_pct = bounced / total * 100; if total = 0 then 0. - Compute system_health_indicators over daily_email_volume: - system_volume_classification from the average daily_emails_sent: ≥1000 High Volume System; ≥500 Medium Volume System; ≥100 Low Volume System; else Minimal Volume System. - delivery_rate_volatility, open_rate_volatility, bounce_rate_volatility are the standard deviations of the corresponding daily percentage metrics. - delivery_stability from the standard deviation of daily_delivery_rate_pct: ≤5 Stable; ≤10 Moderate Variance; else High Variance. - days_of_data = number of daily rows; earliest_activity_date = minimum activity_date; latest_activity_date = maximum activity_date. - Compute deliverability_health across all marts.marketo__email_sends: - Totals: total_email_attempts (all sends), successful_deliveries (delivery true), total_bounces (bounce true). - overall_delivery_rate_pct = delivered / attempts * 100 (2 decimals); overall_bounce_rate_pct = bounces / attempts * 100 (2 decimals). - recent_delivery_rate_pct over the last 30 days: deliveries in last 30 days / total activity in last 30 days * 100 (2 decimals); if no activity in last 30 days then 0. - Compute campaign_health by first aggregating per non-null campaign_id in marts.marketo__email_sends: - Per-campaign averages: open rate = average of opened (as percent); bounce rate = average of bounced (as percent). - Summaries: total_campaigns = distinct campaign_ids; healthy_campaigns = distinct campaigns with open rate ≥25%; critical_campaigns = distinct campaigns with open rate <5%; campaigns_with_bounce_issues = distinct campaigns with bounce rate >10%. - Compute lead_database_health from intermediate.int_marketo__lead l left joined to marts.marketo__email_sends es on lead_id, filtering out deleted or merged leads: - Counts are over the joined rows (not distinct leads): engaged_leads = rows with a match and a click; moderately_engaged_leads = rows with a match and opened but not clicked; low_engaged_leads = rows with a match and not opened; inactive_leads = rows with no matching send; total_leads = total joined rows. - engaged_leads_pct = engaged_leads divided by total joined rows * 100 (2 decimals). - at_risk_leads_pct = rows with no match or with delivery false divided by total joined rows * 100 (2 decimals). - avg_lead_score = average of (count_opens*5 + count_clicks*10) for matched rows, using 0 for no-activity leads; rounded to 2 decimals in the final output. - Final output produces a single-row snapshot with: - health_check_date and health_check_timestamp taken at query time. - deliverability_health_status from overall_delivery_rate_pct: ≥95 Excellent; ≥90 Good; ≥85 Fair; ≥80 Poor; else Critical. - lead_database_health_status from engaged_leads_pct and at_risk_leads_pct: ≥40% engaged and ≤20% at-risk = Excellent; ≥25% and ≤30% = Good; ≥15% and ≤40% = Fair; ≥5% = Poor; else Critical. - healthy_campaigns_pct = healthy_campaigns / total_campaigns * 100 (2 decimals); if total_campaigns = 0 then 0. - Recent 7-day trends as averages of daily_email_volume where activity_date is within the last 7 days; returns NULL if no such days exist. - Volatility metrics are rounded to 2 decimals. - overall_health_score is the sum of four point components based on thresholds (deliverability, engagement, campaign mix, stability); the sum is rounded and stored as an integer (range ~35–100). - primary_recommendation chosen in order: if overall_delivery_rate_pct < 85 then focus on deliverability; else if at_risk_leads_pct > 30 then re-engage leads; else if critical_campaigns > 3 then optimize campaigns; else if delivery_stability is High Variance then stabilize sending; otherwise continue current efforts.'
      columns:
      - name: health_check_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Current date at query time for this snapshot
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: health_check_timestamp
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Current timestamp at query time for this snapshot
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: system_volume_classification
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Classification from average daily_emails_sent (≥1000 High, ≥500 Medium, ≥100 Low, else Minimal)
      - name: delivery_stability
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Stability based on standard deviation of daily_delivery_rate_pct (≤5 Stable, ≤10 Moderate Variance, else High Variance)
      - name: days_of_data
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of daily_email_volume rows included in analysis
      - name: earliest_activity_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Minimum activity_date present in daily_email_volume
      - name: latest_activity_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Maximum activity_date present in daily_email_volume
      - name: total_email_attempts
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Total email send records counted across all time
      - name: successful_deliveries
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of sends where delivery was true
      - name: total_bounces
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of sends where bounce was true
      - name: overall_delivery_rate_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Delivered divided by attempts times 100, rounded to 2 decimals over all sends
      - name: overall_bounce_rate_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Bounces divided by attempts times 100, rounded to 2 decimals over all sends
      - name: recent_delivery_rate_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Deliveries divided by total activity in the last 30 days times 100, rounded to 2 decimals; 0 if no activity
      - name: deliverability_health_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Status from overall_delivery_rate_pct thresholds (≥95 Excellent, ≥90 Good, ≥85 Fair, ≥80 Poor, else Critical)
      - name: total_leads
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Total joined row count after excluding deleted or merged leads
      - name: engaged_leads
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Joined row count with a matched lead and a click
      - name: moderately_engaged_leads
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Joined row count with a matched lead and opened but not clicked
      - name: low_engaged_leads
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Joined row count with a matched lead and not opened
      - name: inactive_leads
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Joined row count where no matching email_sends row exists
      - name: engaged_leads_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Engaged_leads divided by total joined rows times 100, rounded to 2 decimals
      - name: at_risk_leads_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Rows with no match or delivery false divided by total joined rows times 100, rounded to 2 decimals
      - name: avg_lead_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average of (count_opens*5 + count_clicks*10) using 0 for no-activity leads, rounded to 2 decimals
      - name: lead_database_health_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Status from engaged_leads_pct and at_risk_leads_pct thresholds (Excellent, Good, Fair, Poor, Critical)
      - name: total_campaigns
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of distinct campaign_id with activity
      - name: healthy_campaigns
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of distinct campaigns with average open rate ≥25%
      - name: critical_campaigns
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of distinct campaigns with average open rate <5%
      - name: campaigns_with_bounce_issues
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of distinct campaigns with average bounce rate >10%
      - name: healthy_campaigns_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Healthy_campaigns divided by total_campaigns times 100, rounded to 2 decimals; 0 if total_campaigns = 0
      - name: avg_daily_volume_last_7_days
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average daily_emails_sent for activity_date in the last 7 days; NULL if none
      - name: avg_delivery_rate_last_7_days
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average daily_delivery_rate_pct for activity_date in the last 7 days; NULL if none
      - name: avg_open_rate_last_7_days
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average daily_open_rate_pct for activity_date in the last 7 days; NULL if none
      - name: delivery_rate_volatility
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Standard deviation of daily_delivery_rate_pct rounded to 2 decimals; may be NULL if insufficient days
      - name: open_rate_volatility
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Standard deviation of daily_open_rate_pct rounded to 2 decimals; may be NULL if insufficient days
      - name: bounce_rate_volatility
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Standard deviation of daily_bounce_rate_pct rounded to 2 decimals; may be NULL if insufficient days
      - name: overall_health_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Weighted composite score (integer 35–100) from deliverability, engagement, campaign mix, and stability thresholds
      - name: primary_recommendation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Recommendation selected by precedence on deliverability, at-risk leads, critical campaigns, stability, else continue current efforts

references.line_text: business_logic: '- Build daily_email_volume from marts.marketo__email_sends where activity_timestamp is present, grouped by the calendar date of activity_timestamp: - Per-day counts: total emails sent, unique recipients, active campaigns, unique templates, delivered, opened, clicked, bounced, unsubscribes. - Daily rates as percentages rounded to 2 decimals: - daily_delivery_rate_pct = delivered / total * 100; if total = 0 then 0. - daily_open_rate_pct = opened / delivered * 100; if delivered = 0 then 0. - daily_bounce_rate_pct = bounced / total * 100; if total = 0 then 0. - Compute system_health_indicators over daily_email_volume: - system_volume_classification from the average daily_emails_sent: ≥1000 High Volume System; ≥500 Medium Volume System; ≥100 Low Volume System; else Minimal Volume System. - delivery_rate_volatility, open_rate_volatility, bounce_rate_volatility are the standard deviations of the corresponding daily percentage metrics. - delivery_stability from the standard deviation of daily_delivery_rate_pct: ≤5 Stable; ≤10 Moderate Variance; else High Variance. - days_of_data = number of daily rows; earliest_activity_date = minimum activity_date; latest_activity_date = maximum activity_date. - Compute deliverability_health across all marts.marketo__email_sends: - Totals: total_email_attempts (all sends), successful_deliveries (delivery true), total_bounces (bounce true). - overall_delivery_rate_pct = delivered / attempts * 100 (2 decimals); overall_bounce_rate_pct = bounces / attempts * 100 (2 decimals). - recent_delivery_rate_pct over the last 30 days: deliveries in last 30 days / total activity in last 30 days * 100 (2 decimals); if no activity in last 30 days then 0. - Compute campaign_health by first aggregating per non-null campaign_id in marts.marketo__email_sends: - Per-campaign averages: open rate = average of opened (as percent); bounce rate = average of bounced (as percent). - Summaries: total_campaigns = distinct campaign_ids; healthy_campaigns = distinct campaigns with open rate ≥25%; critical_campaigns = distinct campaigns with open rate <5%; campaigns_with_bounce_issues = distinct campaigns with bounce rate >10%. - Compute lead_database_health from intermediate.int_marketo__lead l left joined to marts.marketo__email_sends es on lead_id, filtering out deleted or merged leads: - Counts are over the joined rows (not distinct leads): engaged_leads = rows with a match and a click; moderately_engaged_leads = rows with a match and opened but not clicked; low_engaged_leads = rows with a match and not opened; inactive_leads = rows with no matching send; total_leads = total joined rows. - engaged_leads_pct = engaged_leads divided by total joined rows * 100 (2 decimals). - at_risk_leads_pct = rows with no match or with delivery false divided by total joined rows * 100 (2 decimals). - avg_lead_score = average of (count_opens*5 + count_clicks*10) for matched rows, using 0 for no-activity leads; rounded to 2 decimals in the final output. - Final output produces a single-row snapshot with: - health_check_date and health_check_timestamp taken at query time. - deliverability_health_status from overall_delivery_rate_pct: ≥95 Excellent; ≥90 Good; ≥85 Fair; ≥80 Poor; else Critical. - lead_database_health_status from engaged_leads_pct and at_risk_leads_pct: ≥40% engaged and ≤20% at-risk = Excellent; ≥25% and ≤30% = Good; ≥15% and ≤40% = Fair; ≥5% = Poor; else Critical. - healthy_campaigns_pct = healthy_campaigns / total_campaigns * 100 (2 decimals); if total_campaigns = 0 then 0. - Recent 7-day trends as averages of daily_email_volume where activity_date is within the last 7 days; returns NULL if no such days exist. - Volatility metrics are rounded to 2 decimals. - overall_health_score is the sum of four point components based on thresholds (deliverability, engagement, campaign mix, stability); the sum is rounded and stored as an integer (range ~35–100). - primary_recommendation chosen in order: if overall_delivery_rate_pct < 85 then focus on deliverability; else if at_risk_leads_pct > 30 then re-engage leads; else if critical_campaigns > 3 then optimize campaigns; else if delivery_stability is High Variance then stabilize sending; otherwise continue current efforts.'
